parent_objective: materialize deterministic no-training bounded task-source specs from audited metadata
blocked_by: need spec-level source budget preflight before any environment rollout

public_gates: M1680 must write summary task_source_specs and source_budget_summary artifacts
M1680 must not run environment rollout training replay PPO or promotion
M1680 must not use M1615 hidden/action labels as task targets
M1680 must report source caps T4/T5 balance and control coverage
M1680 must keep private holdout actor-input changes paper-level claims and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M1615 hidden tensors or actions as benchmark targets

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes no-training task-source specs and source-budget summary before rollout
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: spec preflight only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if hidden/action target keys appear
stop if source caps or control coverage are not reported
stop if environment rollout or profile-specific tuning occurs
fallback_plan: route to spec-preflight audit if caps pass
route to source-budget repair design if caps fail
route to mapping repair if leakage guard fails
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1679 admits exactly one no-training task-source spec preflight

admission_evidence: M1679 designs bounded generation with target 72 specs and source caps before rollout
allowed_updates: M1680 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: next audit or repair route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; spec preflight must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, and L3-reset controls for future rollout.
history_necessity_tests: preflight must report control profile coverage
preflight must not claim history necessity from specs
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1679 design and M1677 metadata mapping only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If source caps cannot be met, record source-budget limitation and route to repair before rollout.
allowed_claims: no-training spec preflight and route decision
no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A deterministic no-training generator can materialize source-diverse controller-family task-source specs from the audited M1677 mapping without leakage or rollout.
success_criteria: source caps T4/T5 balance and control coverage are reported
hidden/action target key violation count is zero
environment rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: hidden/action target keys appear in specs
source caps or control coverage are omitted
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
preflight claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID

commands.name: preflight
commands.command: create or run no-training bounded task-source spec generation preflight

decision_rule: M1680 passes if it writes source-budgeted no-training specs with zero leakage and no rollout.
